errors.text_span: 三种不同模型的 F 值随输入项数量的变化趋势
errors.evidence: The chart does not show three different models. It shows the F-values for 30 individual models (solid line), their mean (dotted line), and a post-voting result (dashed line). The x-axis represents the model number, not the 'number of input items'.

errors.text_span: x 轴标有“输入项数量”
errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a label in the figure.
The labeled tick interval on the x-axis is 5 (1, 5, 10, ...), not 1.
The figure's y-axis represents the F-value, but it does not specify that it is in percentage form. This is an assumption.

errors.text_span: 黑色实线代表 30 个模型的 F 值，起始于 77，下降到 69，然后在 15 左右的输入项数量处达到一个较低的值，然后稳定在 69 左右。
errors.evidence: The description of the solid line's trend is completely incorrect. The line starts around 70.5 (not 77) and fluctuates between approximately 69 and 71.5. It does not stabilize at 69.

errors.text_span: 灰色点状线代表 30 个模型的 F 值
errors.evidence: The dotted line represents the 'mean of the F-values of 30 models' (30个模型的F值的均值), not the F-values of the individual models.

errors.text_span: 起始于 69，下降到 67，然后在 5 和 25 左右的输入项数量处出现一个短暂的较低值，然后稳定在 69 左右
errors.evidence: The dotted line is a constant horizontal line at approximately 70.5. The description of a fluctuating trend is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: 代表基于要求的 F 值
errors.evidence: The legend entry for the dashed line is '投票后的F值' (F-value after voting), not 'F-value based on requirements'.

errors.text_span: 从 77 开始，在 10 左右的值下降到 69，然后稳定在 69 左右
errors.evidence: The dashed line is a constant horizontal line at the value of 75. The described trend is completely incorrect.
